The question essentially asks whether it's possible to express all aspects of computer programming using only the principles and operations of Boolean algebra. However, programming languages also involve more complex constructs, such as arithmetic operations, memory management, and high-level abstractions, which might not seem directly related to Boolean algebra at first glance.
